## Blocking items / legal review
- [ ] Confirm full serviceable business street address and postcode for both German Impressum and English imprint. The public legal pages currently omit this required information; omission is not compliance. Add it before relying on the site for commercial operations. DDG §5.
- [ ] Confirm precise legal name (Liffey GbR), partners and representation authority under GbR agreement. Update English and German legal notices if needed.
- [ ] Confirm whether registered as eGbR and disclose Gesellschaftsregister court and number if applicable.
- [ ] Confirm whether VAT ID exists and disclosure is required; add only if issued.
- [ ] Review any applicable professional licensing and supervision; standard recruitment placement is distinct from employee leasing (Arbeitnehmerüberlassung), which can require a permit.
- [ ] Assess editorial responsibility under §18(2) MStV for journalistic-editorial content, including whether a responsible person and address must be displayed for News/Blog.
- [ ] Review German and English privacy notices against actual processing: hosting GitHub Pages, Cloudflare DNS, analytics, applicant emails, retention, international transfers, access requests and processor agreements.
- [ ] Check whether a statutory DPO is required under GDPR Art.37 and BDSG §38; don't designate Leo automatically if independence/conflicts would arise. Leo is currently operational privacy contact, not appointed DPO.
- [ ] Verify candidate privacy notices and recruitment consent/legitimate-interest approach, retention, applicant rights and security.
- [ ] Review website claims, advertised roles and salary ranges for verifiability. Mark illustrative roles clearly and avoid claiming live vacancies without authorization.
- [ ] Review accessibility requirements and ensure mobile keyboard usability, contrast and language variants.
- [ ] Review terms, cookies and tracking statements against actual website behavior; consent requirements depend on technologies used.
- [ ] Have qualified German legal counsel review before commercial launch; these notes are not a legal opinion.

## Content and publishing
- [ ] News articles are retrospective summaries published 2026-10-21, not contemporaneous news from 2018–2025. Do not backdate publication metadata.
- [ ] Verify official sources and article facts individually before promotion; add bylines, substantive citations and last-reviewed dates.
- [ ] Expand editorial archive with original researched articles, not automated duplicate SEO content. Add DE translations and reciprocal hreflang tags.
- [ ] Keep healthcare, immigration, employment, tax and education guidance general, with links to current official rules.
- [ ] Review copyright, trademarks, source licensing, and third-party images before adding any media.
- [ ] Check canonical URLs use https://www.liffey-consulting.com and that non-www redirects.
- [ ] Review navigation, mobile spacing, SEO sitemap, structured data and article pages after deployment.
